content:
Hi all, I’m Lou.

I’ve been spending a lot of time in Lean 4 lately on a project about what epistemic mechanisms become necessary once you assume things like bounded verification, disagreement between agents, coordination, and adversarial pressure. Lately I’ve also been getting more interested in the kernel / metatheory side of Lean because some of my grounding work touches live kernel behavior.

I joined mostly to learn, follow the discussions here, and get a better feel for the work people here are doing.

Happy to be here.
@Lou I moved your message to a new thread as you accidentally posted it in an existing thread. Feel free to rename the thread using the pencil icon next to the title.
